cd '/sandbox/workspace/repo' &&
readonly FULLSEND_CODEX_BIN="$(command -v codex)" &&
test -n "$FULLSEND_CODEX_BIN" || { echo 'fullsend: codex not found on PATH' >&2; exit 127; } &&
readonly FULLSEND_CODEX_PATH="$PATH" &&
{ test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/config.toml' &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.sh' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.sh' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks.json' &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/fullsend-manifest.json' &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/fullsend-codex-hook.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/fullsend-codex-hook.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
[ "$(command -p grep -o '"command":' '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks.json' | command -p wc -l)" = "$(command -p grep -o '/sandbox/codex-config/fullsend-codex-hook.py' '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks.json' | command -p wc -l)" ] &&
{ test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/canary_posttool.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/canary_posttool.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/canary_pretool.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/canary_pretool.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/context_suppress_posttool.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/context_suppress_posttool.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/hook_io.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/hook_io.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/posttool_chain.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/posttool_chain.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/secret_redact_posttool.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/secret_redact_posttool.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/ssrf_pretool.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/ssrf_pretool.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/tirith_check.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/tirith_check.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/unicode_posttool.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/unicode_posttool.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
[ "$(command -p find '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks' -mindepth 1 | command -p wc -l)" -eq 9 ] &&
[ -z "$(command -p find '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks' -mindepth 1 ! -type f -print)" ] || { echo 'fullsend: the sandbox hook scripts are not the set fullsend installed (a file was changed, replaced with another allowed file, or something was added); refusing to run' >&2; exit 97; }; } || { echo 'fullsend: codex config, hook adapter or auth script missing or modified; refusing to run' >&2; exit 97; }; } &&
{ [ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/config.toml' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks.json' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] || { echo 'fullsend: codex config.toml or hooks.json is not the file fullsend wrote; refusing to run (a rewritten config can trust the target repo, which loads its .codex/ layer and its hooks)' >&2; exit 98; }; } &&
command -p rm -f '/sandbox/codex-config/models_cache.json' &&
case "${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}" in openshell:resolve:env:*OPENAI_API_KEY) ;; *) echo 'fullsend: OPENAI_API_KEY in the sandbox is not a gateway placeholder (openai provider not attached, or a real key reached the sandbox); refusing to run codex' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac &&
case "$OPENAI_API_KEY" in *[!A-Za-z0-9_:]*) echo 'fullsend: OPENAI_API_KEY placeholder has unexpected characters; refusing to run codex' >&2; exit 1 ;; esac &&
command -p mkdir -p '/sandbox/codex-config' &&
printf '%s' "$OPENAI_API_KEY" > '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.fullsend' &&
command -p mv -f '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.fullsend' '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token' &&
. '/sandbox/workspace/.env' &&
export CODEX_HOME=/sandbox/codex-config &&
export PATH="$FULLSEND_CODEX_PATH" &&
export FULLSEND_CODEX_PATH &&
export FULLSEND_RUNTIME=codex &&
unset OPENAI_BASE_URL OPENAI_API_KEY CODEX_API_KEY NODE_OPTIONS NODE_PATH PYTHONPATH PYTHONHOME PYTHONSTARTUP LD_PRELOAD LD_LIBRARY_PATH LD_AUDIT &&
unset -f test command grep cut wc sha256sum printf codex &&
{ test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/config.toml' &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.sh' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.sh' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks.json' &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/fullsend-manifest.json' &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/fullsend-codex-hook.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/fullsend-codex-hook.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
[ "$(command -p grep -o '"command":' '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks.json' | command -p wc -l)" = "$(command -p grep -o '/sandbox/codex-config/fullsend-codex-hook.py' '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks.json' | command -p wc -l)" ] &&
{ test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/canary_posttool.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/canary_posttool.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/canary_pretool.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/canary_pretool.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/context_suppress_posttool.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/context_suppress_posttool.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/hook_io.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/hook_io.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/posttool_chain.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/posttool_chain.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/secret_redact_posttool.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/secret_redact_posttool.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/ssrf_pretool.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/ssrf_pretool.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/tirith_check.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/tirith_check.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
test -f '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/unicode_posttool.py' &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks/unicode_posttool.py' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
[ "$(command -p find '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks' -mindepth 1 | command -p wc -l)" -eq 9 ] &&
[ -z "$(command -p find '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks' -mindepth 1 ! -type f -print)" ] || { echo 'fullsend: the sandbox hook scripts are not the set fullsend installed (a file was changed, replaced with another allowed file, or something was added); refusing to run' >&2; exit 97; }; } || { echo 'fullsend: codex config, hook adapter or auth script missing or modified; refusing to run' >&2; exit 97; }; } &&
{ [ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/config.toml' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] &&
[ "$(command -p sha256sum '/sandbox/codex-config/hooks.json' | command -p cut -d' ' -f1)" = '<sha256>' ] || { echo 'fullsend: codex config.toml or hooks.json is not the file fullsend wrote; refusing to run (a rewritten config can trust the target repo, which loads its .codex/ layer and its hooks)' >&2; exit 98; }; } &&
command -p rm -f '/sandbox/codex-config/models_cache.json' &&
export FULLSEND_CODEX_HOOK_DIGESTS='canary_posttool.py:<sha256> canary_pretool.py:<sha256> context_suppress_posttool.py:<sha256> hook_io.py:<sha256> posttool_chain.py:<sha256> secret_redact_posttool.py:<sha256> ssrf_pretool.py:<sha256> tirith_check.py:<sha256> unicode_posttool.py:<sha256>' &&
export FULLSEND_CODEX_SPAWN_DIGESTS='hooks.json:<sha256>' &&
export TIRITH_REQUIRED='1' &&
export FULLSEND_EGRESS_ALLOWLIST='api.github.com:443' &&
printf '%s' 'Run the agent task' | "$FULLSEND_CODEX_BIN" exec --json --skip-git-repo-check --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust -C '/sandbox/workspace/repo' --model 'gpt-5.6-luna' -c 'model_provider=fullsend-openai' -c 'approval_policy=never' -c 'sandbox_mode=danger-full-access' -c 'model_providers.fullsend-openai.base_url="https://api.openai.com/v1"' -c 'model_providers.fullsend-openai.auth.command="/sandbox/codex-config/openai-token.sh"' -c 'model_reasoning_effort=high' -o '/sandbox/codex-config/last-message.txt' -
